description: Extract from #34531. This will reduce unnecessary count operation in databases.

comments.body:
That's an improper name.

It is in the `modules/git` package, does `modules/git.getBase` make a clear meaning?
And why it is a `var`? I don't see where it is mocked.

~~I do not think it is right.~~

~~`Find(&statuses)` might change the value of `statuses`, then the first returned `statuses` might be wrong.~~

Maybe Golang spec guarantees that the function call will be executed before reading the variable values (not sure), I still think we should avoid using such trick syntax.
